# cost-savers

> Six OpenCode plugins and four CLI tools that cut what coding agents send to paid models, with a pre-registered paired A/B.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers && cd cost-savers && make test` (expect: All cost-savers tests PASSED.).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
